cross.note: Shares are computed from the counts the compendium prints; each block names its agency and period.

censusSexRatio.note: Women per 1,000 men in the whole population, census years; no census since 2011.

lokSabhaWomenShare.note: women elected as a share of seats, computed from the compendium's counts

womenShareOfAccounts.note: per cent of accounts or holders in women's names, latest date each source reports (2025)

convictionShareAllCrimesAgainstWomen.note: convictions as a share of all cases due for trial in the year, including the backlog; not the usual conviction rate

spousalViolenceCompendium.note: married women 18-49 who experienced physical or sexual violence by a husband, NFHS reprinted in the compendium (two survey rounds)
